title: Multi-Line Relationship Reduction on the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Return Fee
content:
**Relationship pricing — return fee.** The return fee on a vehicle returned under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is reduced by the number of Kestrel consumer lines in which the customer holds an active account. The three lines counted are the **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**, the **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** and the **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**.

| Lines with an active Kestrel account | Reduction of the return fee |
|---|---|
| Two or three | USD 100.00 |
| Exactly one | USD 50.00 |
| None | None |

A line counts once whatever the number of active accounts in it, and only accounts in active status count; a paid-in-full or closed contract does not.

## Hypothetical cases

- An active lease and an active pre-owned retail contract: two lines, USD 100.00.
- An active new-vehicle retail contract only: one line, USD 50.00.
- A closed lease and nothing else: no line, no reduction.
